returned.detail: re-rooted at stage 1 as architecture 3, a new decisive step in architecture 2's world. Diagnosis: clause 3.1 obliged every solver to produce a residual and the pack offered exactly one place to get one, labelled in the equipment log's own words as the weekly MCC inspection, so the step the filed clause demanded and the data supplied in one move was found by both threads. The ask layer's measured 37.3 pair ceiling proved nothing: a pair ceiling cannot validate the ladder it assumes (the rule filed from task190). Architecture 3 makes the plant-off windows the attractive wrong route, because they fall between 04:30 and 06:45, outside the 07:00 to 19:00 assessment period, where the roads are empty and the dawn chorus is loudest, so the non-plant sound they record is a different mixture by a different amount at every position; the residual that holds is estimated inside the assessment period from each position's own level against the plant's recorded aeration output, extrapolated to zero output. Two judge findings bind the new build as design constraints: the figures the prompt's rounding sentence governs are checked for printed precision in the verifier, and no shipped sentence names what a rejected route would give unless each route is recomputed and its candidates named exactly. The three realism findings (the plan's tutoring sentences, survey_notes.md itemising defects and pointing at what was not collected, the complaints register's one-row-per-contact header against C01 repeating five times) are in scope. Architecture 2's evidence is filed in determinism_check_report.md and in leak_check_report.md under ## Solver's-eye read.
